presentation.description: Housing placement toolkit for FFXIV. Know before you place: floor-snap warnings from the engine's own collision data, item-to-item snap warnings from each item's SphereCastRange block, wall-snap warnings against false-wall furniture, and table-snap warnings from TableTop collision surfaces. Full position/rotation control on top, inherited from BDTH by LeonBlade. Open with /hu. ⚠ Under active testing — not a fully working product yet; features may be incomplete or behave unexpectedly.
